decisions.reason: Although this pegboard-backed cardboard display fits the core business, several years without visible promotion suggest it has not met aspiration strongly enough as a distinct offer, so we would redeploy the resources.
A quarter-pallet cardboard display sits very close to the firm's central capabilities and customer needs, so we would keep it unless current internal results clearly fall below aspiration.
The eighth-pallet format serves a narrower retail use case and appears less salient after launch, so it likely underperforms broader core formats relative to aspiration and should be withdrawn.
The wooden display pallet is farther from the cardboard-centered core and likely did not justify its added complexity after the trial period, so we would drop it.

This media-focused quarter-pallet display is a more specialized niche product and likely compares unfavorably with general display solutions, so we would shift capacity to stronger core and new developments.
